# thetalake_integration (Resource)

The integration resource allows for the creation and management of integrations within Theta Lake. Exactly one of `generic_journaling`, `google_workspace_email`, or `theta_lake_api` must be set; whichever is set determines the integration's type, which cannot be changed after creation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "undeliverable_mailbox_password" {
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
  description = "Password for the mailbox that receives undeliverable email notifications."
}

resource "thetalake_integration" "journaling" {
  name   = "Custom Generic Journaling Integration"
  paused = false

  generic_journaling = {
    download_o365_onedrive_links = true
    index_headers                = "X-Header-Score,X-Routed-Via"
    undeliverable_email_server   = "email.example.com"
    undeliverable_email_user     = "Undeliverable User"
    undeliverable_email_password = var.undeliverable_mailbox_password
    undeliverable_email_port     = 993
  }
}

resource "thetalake_integration" "api" {
  name           = "Custom Theta Lake API Integration"
  theta_lake_api = {}
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the integration

### Optional

- `generic_journaling` (Attributes) Configuration options for a Generic Journaling integration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--generic_journaling))
- `google_workspace_email` (Attributes) Configuration options for a Google Workspace Email integration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--google_workspace_email))
- `paused` (Boolean) Indicates if the integration is paused. Changing this after creation calls the pause/start endpoints rather than updating the integration directly.
- `theta_lake_api` (Attributes) Selects the Theta Lake API integration type. This integration type has no configuration options, so the object must be set but is always empty (`{}`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--theta_lake_api))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The created timestamp using the RFC3339 date-time format
- `id` (Number) The integration ID
- `integration_group` (String) The category the integration belongs to (e.g. "Collaboration Platform")
- `integration_type` (String) Name of the service integrated with
- `integration_type_id` (Number) Theta Lake's internal integration type ID
- `type` (String) The type of integration, derived from whichever of `generic_journaling`, `google_workspace_email`, or `theta_lake_api` is set

<a id="nestedatt--generic_journaling"></a>
### Nested Schema for `generic_journaling`

Optional:

- `download_o365_onedrive_links` (Boolean) Indicates if links to Microsoft OneDrive/O365 documents found in email should be downloaded and included in the archived record
- `download_salesforce_doclinks` (Boolean) Indicates if Salesforce document links found in email should be downloaded and included in the archived record
- `index_headers` (String) A comma separated list of email headers that should be indexed for search
- `sender_spf_override` (String) An SPF DNS TXT record value used to override sender validation for the integration's journaling domain
- `undeliverable_disabled` (Boolean) Indicates if handling of undeliverable (bounce) email is disabled for this integration
- `undeliverable_email_address` (String) The email address used to receive undeliverable (bounce) notifications for this integration
- `undeliverable_email_password` (String, Sensitive) The password used to authenticate with the undeliverable email mailbox. On create and update the configured value is authoritative; a password changed outside Terraform is detected on refresh.
- `undeliverable_email_port` (Number) The port used to connect to the undeliverable email mailbox's server
- `undeliverable_email_server` (String) The hostname of the mail server used to check for undeliverable (bounce) email
- `undeliverable_email_user` (String) The username used to authenticate with the undeliverable email mailbox


<a id="nestedatt--google_workspace_email"></a>
### Nested Schema for `google_workspace_email`

Optional:

- `download_o365_onedrive_links` (Boolean) Indicates if links to Microsoft OneDrive/O365 documents found in email should be downloaded and included in the archived record
- `index_headers` (String) A comma separated list of email headers that should be indexed for search
- `sender_spf_override` (String) An SPF DNS TXT record value used to override sender validation for the integration's journaling domain
- `undeliverable_email_address` (String) The email address used to receive undeliverable (bounce) notifications for this integration
